note: Both sets capture the same core facts (outboard 5% drop from the Prandtl tip loss model, design TSR 9.0, optimal TSR 8.5, 4° max pitch at low wind, force peak near 90 m) with supporting quotes. Set A redundantly lists the 4° pitch limit twice under two entity names, a trivial duplicate, while Set B states it once and usefully adds the Region 1.5 context that the text links to the low-wind pitch behavior. Set B's 'maximum CP' condition on the optimal TSR is loosely worded but consistent with the CP-curve discussion, and its 'design point' condition is merely circular rather than wrong. Neither set records the optimal pitch of −1.0° or the design pitch of 0°, so both are incomplete to a similar degree.
